name: Institutional Claim Code
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837Q3.I.5010.X223.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2, institutional-only (no professional/837P equivalent). CL104 (Nursing Home Residential Status Code) is usage=N at the real occurrence — dropped.

USAGE CORRECTION (EDI Phase 7, September 2026): originally modeled usage='required', which the builder enforces globally per-segment-ID (no per-loop override exists in this engine — SegmentIDs is a plain []string). This broke 278 (Stedi stedi.com/edi/hipaa/transaction-set/278-A1 explicitly documents CL1 as 'O, max=1' — Institutional Claim Code at 278's own 2000E Patient Event level, only relevant when the review concerns an institutional/inpatient service), a genuinely different, correct real-world requirement from 837I's own usage. Corrected to 'situational' — every existing 837I round-trip test still supplies CL1 in its own fixture regardless (this segment IS practically always populated for a real institutional claim), so this widening is purely permissive and changes no existing behavior; re-verified zero regressions after the change.
